visualCharacteristics.structure: circular avatar + centered name + uppercase role + social icon links

contentPattern: Grid of person profiles: one row per person; cell 1 circular avatar picture, cell 2 name (h3), role line, and a list of social icon links (Facebook, Twitter, Instagram).
